# 3d-arrow-ribbon

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Fat 3D chevron arrows and folded ribbons carrying a sequence. Backdrop: Light studio, dotted world map. Items: 4 to 8. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Family item colours applied as a smooth gradient along the flow (purple, blue, teal, green) or as discrete blocks per arrow
- Light studio backdrop with an optional dotted world map at 5 to 8 percent opacity
- Arrow top faces lighter, side faces darker, giving the chevrons visible thickness

## Visual elements

- Chevron arrows nest into each other, the point of one entering the notch of the next
- The flow rises, dips or curves; it is never a flat straight bar
- One flat icon per arrow sits on the top face, in white or in the arrow colour
- Leader lines drop from each icon to a text block alternating above and below the flow
- Ribbon variant: angled folded bands stacked vertically, each with a hexagon tab and a slim chevron pointer to an icon
- Optional small figure or object at the end of the flow as the goal marker

## Typography

- Family typography; step names bold caps, descriptions light charcoal in two to four short lines
- Title top-centre, two-tone (bold word plus light word)

## Composition rules

- Landscape only for the chevron variant; the flow spans 85 to 90 percent of the width
- Five to eight arrows; fewer than five, use 3d-disc-timeline
- Text blocks alternate above and below so no two adjacent labels collide
- Ribbon variant works in portrait and square

## Layout

### Structure

- Single flow of chevron arrows nesting point-into-notch, left to right
- One arrow per step, coloured in order
- Flow rises, dips or curves; never a flat bar
- Labels hang off thin leader lines alternating above and below the flow
- Optional spurs leaving an arrow for side outputs
- Optional goal marker at the end of the flow

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Chevron flow** | Pipelines, journeys, momentum | Interlocking arrows, gradient along the flow |
| **Folded ribbon tiers** | Stacked stages, funnels | Angled bands stacked vertically with hexagon tabs |
| **Arrow bars** | Options ranked or compared | Horizontal arrows stacked from a left spine, stepped lengths, numeral at the head or on the spine |
| **Angled banners** | Numbered option list | Stacked horizontal banners, diagonal colour split, big numeral left, title and icon right |

### Visual Elements

- Arrows with visible thickness, top faces lighter, side faces darker
- One flat icon or numeral riding on each arrow top face
- Leader lines with dot terminals to text blocks
- Thin parallel rail under the flow for cross-cutting items
- Ribbon variant: hexagon letter tab and slim chevron pointer per band
- Arrow bars: one arrow per option from a pale left spine, lengths stepped, numerals 01 to 04 on the spine or in the arrow head
- Angled banners: one banner per option, left third in the item colour cut on a diagonal, white right part with title, body and icon

### Text Placement

- Title at top
- Step names above the flow, detail lines below, alternating per arrow
- Rail labels along the rail
- Flow spans 85 to 90 percent of the canvas width
- Landscape only for the chevron variant

```

Colours run in order along the flow from purple through royal blue and teal to lime green (or one saturated colour per arrow). A flat white icon rides on each arrow; a thin leader line with a dot terminal drops to its label, alternating above and below the flow. Light off-white studio backdrop with a faint dotted world map. Geometric sans-serif: bold all-caps step names, light charcoal descriptions, two-tone title. No hand-drawn lines, no paper texture, no cartoon characters, no photographic realism, no watermarks, no placeholder text. Clean premium business-template 3D.
